lines.text: Freesia wanders the streets with her cap pulled low over her eyes and a mask hiding the rest of her face.
Hanson walks at her side, matching her pace without a word.
Up ahead, a citizen presses an empty can into the hand of a Nikke walking down the street.
The last of its contents already drained.
The Nikke lets out a sigh, takes it from him, and tosses it into a nearby trash bin.
Freesia and Hanson keep moving.
The Nikkes stationed at the public facility stand guard, their uniforms disheveled and their bodies worn and battered.
A group of students lingers nearby, snickering as they hurl scraps of food at them for sport.
The Nikkes don't react. They don't even flinch.
No one steps in. No one tells the students to stop.
Freesia and Hanson continue down the street.
In a dark corner of the park, a mass-produced Nikke is getting pummeled, her body swaying with each hit.
It isn't supposed to hurt. The attackers wield nothing but cheap plastic rods and their own hands, hardly enough to cause real damage.
But that Nikke's face twists in pain.
Freesia and Hanson keep walking down the street.
They pass a shop where a Nikke stands awkwardly at the entrance.
The owner refuses to sell to her. She fidgets in place, unsure whether to plead or leave.
From the neighboring store, another shopkeeper watches her with open pity but says nothing.
Freesia and Hanson keep walking.
A little farther on, a drunken man uses a Nikke as a target for his slurred abuse.
Another is subjected to crude jeers and harassment.
One stands rigid as someone spits in her face.
And then...
a citizen breaks down in front of another Nikke and shouts,
"It's because you lost that we ended up like this!"
The Nikke lowers her head like a criminal awaiting judgment, simply enduring it without protest.
Freesia and Hanson turn their eyes away from the scene and continue on.
They find a quiet spot in the far corner of the park and sit down.
Freesia's tears fall.
She weeps over and over, lost in her sorrow.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: This is all my fault...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I caused this.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Things were different in your heyday.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I can't say there were no Nikkephobes, but people were careful about how they acted.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: At least society treated Nikkes kindly back then.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Everyone believed you would be a symbol forever.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: There's no such thing as forever, is there?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Everyone expects me to be perfect.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I can do it

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: but it never ends.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: How long do I have to keep being flawless?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I'm tired too. It's hard.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: And the moment I slip up even a little, everyone judges me even more harshly.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: And that affects the whole world.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Because I'm a symbol, and everyone looks up to me.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: So I gave up. It was just too much.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... And this is the result.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I don't know if I can do it again. Because... it would never end.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... If only Mister were here...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Tell me...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: What exactly am I supposed to do, Hanson?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I don't know.
*Bzzz*
*Bzzz*

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... Take it. I'm sure it's Mustang.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Sorry.
Hanson answers the phone. A torrent of shouting blasts from the other end, harsh and unrelenting.
When he hangs up, he turns to Freesia with an unreadable expression.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... Go ahead.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I'm just going to sit here for a bit.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Sorry.
Freesia does not respond.
Hanson rises from his seat, casts her a quick glance, and then takes off running.
The park is silent under the night sky.
Freesia stares into the empty space, lost in thought.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I just don't know anymore.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: C-c-c-can...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: C-can I get your autograph...?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... Who are you?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: F-f-fan. I-I'm your fan.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... You know who I am?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Pretty...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... How'd you know?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Your body shape and fashion style...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... You're a stalker?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: No way.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: How on earth did you figure out it's me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: 'Cause I'm a fan...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: How old are you?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Seventeen...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: ... You're still so young.
Freesia stares at Anis intently.
Her eyes glitter with excitement, betraying the thrill she's trying to contain. It's the unmistakable expression of a fan.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Sit. I've been feeling a bit down, so let's chat for a while.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wow, really?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Shh! Keep it down, someone might hear us.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hehe. Hehehe.
Anis sits down next to Freesia.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wow, this feels like a dream.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Why do you like me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Because whenever I see you, I feel like I can take on anything.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I don't know... You just give me strength.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You know, I used to get picked on for standing up to the popular kid in class,

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: but listening to your songs helped me get through it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And now, I feel like I can handle whatever comes next.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: It's like this little spark of hope that tells me things are gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Hope...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: At first, your songs totally saved me... Wait, scratch that. They gave me strength.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Then just seeing you on TV was enough to keep me going.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And now? Even a photo of you does the trick.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I've been stirring up all kinds of trouble lately.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Uh... can't say for sure. I've mostly just been listening to your songs lately.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: So, for me, you're still at your absolute coolest.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Hehe, is that so?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Thank you. You really know how to comfort people, and you're so mature for your age.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh, right! I've been practicing Pretty Star lately. Wanna see?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm going to perform in the school talent show. You know that super-popular kid I told you about?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah, she set me up for this on purpose to screw me over.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Kids these days really don't mince their words.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm gonna go out there and blow everyone's socks off!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Plus, I've got a f-friend helping me too.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: And after that?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I haven't really thought about it... Just wanna get a little payback.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: You've got a dream, hope, and the drive to make it happen.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Did I... really give you hope?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Can I really keep doing this?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You've done it all along, and I'm sure you'll keep going.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Haha, okay.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Let's see you dance. Show me what you've got.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh? Really?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Yeah.
The quiet park comes alive under the night sky.
Anis dances with pure joy, as Freesia watches, a soft smile lighting her face.
A song signaling the start of their journey plays vividly in their minds.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: One, two, three, four. And stretch...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Streeetch!

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Yes, that's it! That's it!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And right here. Bam, bam, bam!

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Wow, you're really talented.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh yeah? You think I can get back at her?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: For sure, she won't know what hit her!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: That was so much fun.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hehe. I know, right?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: By the way, I noticed you always tilt your head back during breaks on stage. Why do you do that?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Is it some kind of breathing technique?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: I do? How'd you know?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Well... I've watched tons of your practice videos and stuff...

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Oh wow, you're such a big fan.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Damn right!

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Up on the surface,

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: it was so nice to just sit and watch the clouds pass by.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Especially when you'd been waiting for someone endlessly. Somehow, watching them made time fly, and it felt really good.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh...
Anis looks up at the sky.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I can't see anything, though.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Well, yeah. It's night, and we're not even on the surface.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Whoa, it's getting pretty late! Shouldn't you be heading home and getting some sleep?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh... yeah.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Oh yeah, the autograph! I almost forgot the most important thing.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: It's fine. I already got something way better.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Hehe, fair enough.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hang in there, Pretty.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You've got this.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I don't know all the details, but hang in there.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: To me, you'll always be my idol.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: Me... your idol forever? Really?

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: All right, I'll hang in there. Thank you.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hehe. All right,

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm off. Take care now.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: See ya. Stay safe.
Anis runs ahead, brimming with energy.
Freesia watches her for a while, then turns and starts walking away.

lines.speaker: pretty_casual
lines.text: An idol forever...
